class.name: EGPLiteSession
class.brief_description: Native facade for the EGP managed LiteNetLib and LiteEntitySystem runtime.
class.description: Construct and retain a Godot.EGPLiteRuntime in C# with your entity type map, then pass its Bridge to GDScript or native code. Poll this facade on the owning game thread. It shares the same transport, replication and simulation loop as C#. Node RPC and MultiplayerSynchronizer are not part of this protocol.

method.name: attach_runtime
method.description: Attaches one managed dispatcher. A second attachment fails.

method.name: detach_runtime
method.description: Stops and releases the managed dispatcher. Dispose the retained EGPLiteRuntime when finished.

method.name: has_runtime
method.description: Returns whether the managed runtime is attached.

method.name: listen
method.description: Starts an authoritative UDP server. Port zero selects an available port.

method.name: connect_to_server
method.description: Connects after checking the game, replication and simulation fingerprints.

method.name: poll
method.description: Delivers network events and advances internal fixed ticks and prediction replay.

method.name: stop
method.description: Closes sockets and resets entity lifetime.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns counters, peer count, tick values and interpolation buffer size.

method.name: send_application
method.description: Sends bounded reliable application bytes over channel one. IDs are transport peer IDs.

signal.name: diagnostic
signal.description: A socket or packet diagnostic occurred.
